name: Jan de Vries
bio:
Jan's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a love of racing, but through a fascination with organizational efficiency. After earning a degree in Human Resources from the University of Amsterdam, he spent several years streamlining operations for a large multinational corporation. While successful, he felt a lack of passion. A chance encounter with a former F1 engineer at a local pub sparked his interest in the unique challenges of motorsport. Jan believes in fostering a supportive and growth-oriented environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. He focuses on identifying and nurturing talent, ensuring that the team has the right people in the right roles to achieve success.

Jan is known for his meticulous approach and data-driven decision-making. He's not afraid to challenge the status quo and implement innovative HR strategies to improve team performance and morale. He is particularly interested in the psychological aspects of high-performance environments and how to mitigate stress and burnout within racing teams. His attention to detail and commitment to excellence make him a valuable asset to any organization looking to build a winning team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jan is of average height with a slightly stocky build and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with HR-related articles and ideas.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of ergonomic keyboard.
